The negative elasticity indicates that as unemployment insurance contributions decreased from January to March 1960, total collections increased. This makes economic sense - when unemployment insurance (a tax on employers) decreases, it could indicate lower employment/wages, but there may be timing effects with tax payments (quarterly estimates due in March).
